newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures closed mixed in brisk spread trade.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures closed mixed in brisk spread trade.

text.p: FCOJ futures ended tightly mixed with activity focused on the July/September spread, traders said.
Open interest in the spot July contract fell by 487 lots as of Wednesday, while September gained 490 lots.
July orange juice settled 0.30 cent higher at 76.10 cents per lb, after ranging from 77.00 to 75.35 cents. September ended down 0.05, and the rest of the board closed 0.15 lower to 0.05 higher.
An estimated 4,000 lots changed hands on the day, compared with Tuesday's official 2,733 lots.
Technical analysts said the market should trade sideways to lower until July options expire on Friday, and then ease further.
Support in July was seen at 72.30 cents and then at 70.35 cents.
